name: Carried Grain
description: Throw a handful of grains on a wind that carries them hard and flat at the face.

name: Windsand Cloak
description: Wear a cloak of sand spun by a steady wind that scours whatever touches it.

name: Gust Skid
description: Skid forward on a gust that drives a wake of grains behind the heels.

name: Windsand Lash
description: Lash a front of foes with a long whip of sand and wind from one side to the other.

name: Blinding Windsand
description: Drive a thick blast of sand-laden wind into the eyes of every foe facing the user.

name: Sand Eddy
description: Spin a small eddy of sand-bearing wind round the target's arms to pull their guard apart.

name: Windsand Lance
description: Compress sand into a wind-driven lance that tears through a guard at speed.

name: Sandspout
description: Raise a tall twisting spout of sand and wind that hurls everything near it outward.

name: Windsand Maw
description: Open a vast maw of wind and sand that drags foes in and grinds them as they fall.

name: Razor Sandwind
description: streams: Sand + Wind; give the wind an edge of sand so the whole field is cut by a single blade of air.

name: Warm Sand
description: Strike with a fist of sand heated enough to scorch the skin it touches.

name: Glaze Skin
description: Fuse the outer sand of the body into a thin glaze that turns blades.

name: Kiln Skid
description: Skid across hot sand that fuses behind the heel into a smooth trail.

name: Kiln Sense
description: Read each footfall from how the warm sand glazes under weight.

name: Searing Sand
description: Hurl a fistful of sand heated white that sticks and burns on contact.

name: Glazing Touch
description: Touch the target's limb and glaze the sand on it into a brittle hard shell.

name: Sandcinder Veil
description: Hang a hot veil of sand and cinder that dazzles and stings the eyes.

name: Fused Turn
description: Turn a blow aside against a pane of fused sand that rings and holds.

name: Glassfire Spray
description: Spray a wide fan of molten sand that sets to glass on the foes it lands upon.

name: Slag Lance
description: Cast a lance of half-melted sand that burns through shield and cloth together.

name: Glass Shardfall
description: Shatter a sky of glass sheets above the field and let the shards rain down.

name: Vitrify
description: streams: Sand + Fire; heat the field of sand past melting and let it set to glass around every foe.

name: Wet Grain
description: Strike with a heavy fist of wet sand that thuds like a sack of stones.

name: Slurry Cloak
description: Pull a thick cloak of slurry round the shoulders that smothers cutting edges.

name: Slurry Skid
description: Skid over a sheet of slurry that thins under the foot and thickens behind it.

name: Slurry Bind
description: Wind thick slurry about the target's legs and let it set round the ankles.

name: Sinking Slurry
description: Soften the ground to slurry so each step drags the foe deeper.

name: Slurry Wave
description: Send a low heavy wave of slurry across a group of foes and knock them flat.

name: Wet Turn
description: Turn a strike aside on a slick film of slurry that lets it slide off the arm.

name: Slurry Burial
description: Pour slurry over the foe in one heavy tide and set it hard to the chest.

name: Slurry Spear
description: Drive a spear of packed slurry through a shield and into the body behind.

name: Drowning Slurry
description: Raise a dune of slurry that falls upon the field and holds all it covers.

name: Sinking Tide
description: streams: Sand + Water; make the ground a slow tide of sand and water that drags the foes under.
